appDescription: A driving companion that remembers the promises the driver made and closes them by voice during the trip.

function.name: BRIEF_MY_PROMISES
function.description: Read out the open promises the driver made to other people that are due today.

function.name: ADD_PROMISE
function.description: Save a new promise the driver just made so it is tracked until it is closed.

counterpart.description: The person the promise was made to.

content.description: What the driver promised to do.

dueDateTime.description: When the promise is due, in ISO 8601 date and time format.

function.name: SEND_ARRIVAL_UPDATE
function.description: Send the person waiting at the current destination a short message with the estimated arrival time.

counterpart.description: The person to notify about the arrival time.
